name: rps-keypoint-classifier

input.coordinateSpace: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker normalized image coordinates

classRules.rock: index, middle, ring, and pinky are curled, with tolerance for one noisy front-finger landmark
classRules.paper: index, middle, ring, and pinky are extended
classRules.scissors: index and middle are extended while ring and pinky are curled
classRules.none: no hand, very low quality landmarks, unusual finger count without a known RPS shape, or ambiguous class margin

notes: Bootstrap classifier for the first MediaPipe version. Version 0.1.1 reduces false none predictions for rock/fist poses caused by curled-finger landmark occlusion. It is intentionally stored as JSON so a trained lightweight classifier can replace it without changing the courseware UI or platform integration.
